intents.name: Verify email address
intents.description: Check whether an email address is valid, live, and retrieve deliverability details such as typo correction and confidence score.

intents.name: list_all_car_makes
intents.description: Retrieve the complete list of car makes from the dataset.

intents.name: fetch_animal_facts
intents.description: User wants scientific facts about a particular animal, providing its common name (partial matches allowed).

intents.name: search_by_state
intents.description: Find public restrooms filtered by one or more US state abbreviations.

intents.name: search_by_coordinates
intents.description: Find public restrooms near a specific latitude and longitude.

intents.name: Search dog breed metadata
intents.description: Retrieve basic metadata for dog breeds that match a given search term.

intents.name: convert_number_to_words
intents.description: User wants the textual representation of a numeric value.

intents.name: fetch_random_joke
intents.description: When the user wants a random joke with no specific criteria.

intents.name: Get media news
intents.description: Retrieve current or trending news about movies, TV shows, and celebrities, optionally filtered by category, country/language, and paginated.

intents.name: search_manga_by_text
intents.description: Find manga matching a text query, optionally filtering by NSFW status and origin.

intents.name: real_time_quote
intents.description: Retrieve the latest price and volume for a single ticker.

intents.name: daily_historical_prices
intents.description: Fetch daily open/high/low/close data for a ticker over a recent period.

intents.name: intraday_time_series
intents.description: Obtain intraday price data for a ticker at a specific interval.

intents.name: company_overview
intents.description: Get descriptive information about a company such as sector, market cap, and description.

intents.name: earnings_data
intents.description: Retrieve earnings reports or calendar data for a ticker.

intents.name: sector_performance
intents.description: Return performance metrics for all market sectors (no specific ticker required).

intents.name: convert_between_currencies
intents.description: Convert an amount from one currency to another, optionally specifying the base and/or target currency codes (defaults: USD to JPY).

intents.name: principal_based_payment
intents.description: User knows the loan principal and wants the basic monthly principal‑and‑interest payment.

intents.name: price_and_downpayment_payment
intents.description: User knows the home price and downpayment and wants the mortgage payment derived from those values.

intents.name: total_ownership_cost
intents.description: User wants the full monthly cost of owning the home, including HOA fees, property tax and insurance.

intents.name: Retrieve inflation data
intents.description: Obtain the latest inflation statistics for major countries, optionally specifying CPI or HICP as the indicator type.

intents.name: search_recipe_by_name
intents.description: Find recipes whose dish name includes the specified query text.

intents.name: search_cocktails
intents.description: Find cocktail recipes using a name query, a list of ingredients, or a combination of both.

intents.name: list_all_characters
intents.description: Retrieve the complete list of MVC2 (Marvel Vs Capcom) characters.

intents.name: Get giveaways by platform (optional type)
intents.description: Retrieve game giveaways filtered by one or more platforms, optionally narrowing results by giveaway type.

intents.name: Get champion stats by name
intents.description: Retrieve the basic metadata and in‑game statistics for a specific champion when you know the champion's name.

intents.name: salary_estimation_lookup
intents.description: Retrieve salary estimation data for a given job title and location, optionally narrowing by location type, experience level, or selecting specific fields.

intents.name: Get timezone info for a location
intents.description: Retrieve the UTC and DST offsets for a given latitude/longitude, optionally for a specific UNIX timestamp (defaults to the current time).

intents.name: lookup_by_name
intents.description: Retrieve data for a specific planet when its name is known.

intents.name: search_by_attributes
intents.description: Find planets that satisfy one or more numeric attribute ranges (mass, radius, orbital period, temperature, distance).

intents.name: Get celestial body position
intents.description: Retrieve the azimuth and altitude of a specified celestial body for a given observer location over a date range, optionally providing elevation and a specific time.

intents.name: search_arxiv
intents.description: Retrieve arXiv papers matching a search term, optionally filtered by field, date range, and pagination.

intents.name: list_all_tournaments
intents.description: Retrieve the complete list of soccer tournaments.

intents.name: fetch_latest_f1_news
intents.description: Retrieve the most recent Formula 1 news articles from all sources.

intents.name: Get matches for a date
intents.description: Retrieve the list of scheduled handball matches for a specific date within the allowed ±7‑day range.

intents.name: lookup_airline
intents.description: Retrieve airline information using an ICAO code, IATA code, or airline name (supports partial matches).

intents.name: Lookup motorcycle data
intents.description: Retrieve detailed technical specifications for motorcycles, optionally filtering by make, model, and/or year.

intents.name: Air quality by coordinates
intents.description: Retrieve the latest air quality data for a location when the latitude and longitude are known.

intents.name: Air quality by place name
intents.description: Retrieve the latest air quality data for a location using its city name, optionally refined with state and/or country.

intents.name: get_weather_forecast
intents.description: Retrieve an hourly or 15‑minute weather forecast for a location specified by city name, coordinates, postal code, airport/IATA code, METAR code, or IP address.
